summary: Iteration 106 - Verified 2 backend bug fixes: (1) MO cancellation cascade to all uncompleted child WOs, (2) Preview permission relaxation for manufacturing:view users. All 9 new tests passed + 35 regression tests from iter-99/102/103/104/105 passed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_VAR_106_ prefixed items during tests, all cleaned up after each test class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both backend fixes verified working. Fix 1: MO cancellation now cascades to all uncompleted child WOs recursively (BFS over parent_wo_id tree), sets cancelled_by_parent on children, releases child_reservations. Fix 2: Preview permission split - manufacturing:view allows ?preview=true, manufacturing:edit required for actual start.

backend.details: Created FG→SG→RM BOM chain. Created MO for FG (auto-creates child WO for SG). Cancelled main MO. Verified child WO status=cancelled with cancelled_by_parent=main_mo_id, and main WO has cascade_cancelled_children containing child id.
Created MO for FG. Verified child_reservations created. Cancelled main MO. Verified reserved_stock on SG item was released (decremented).
Created MO, started and completed child WO, then cancelled main MO. Verified completed child WO stays completed (not cancelled).
Created 3-level BOM (FG→SG1→SG2→RM). Created MO for FG. Cancelled main MO. Verified ALL descendants (SG1 WO, SG2 WO) are cancelled with cancelled_by_parent=main_mo_id.
Created user with only manufacturing:view permission. Called POST /api/work-orders/{id}/start?preview=true. Got 200 with consumed_materials payload.
View-only user called POST /api/work-orders/{id}/start (no preview). Got 403 Forbidden as expected.
Admin can call both ?preview=true (200) and actual start (not 403).
Items, BOMs, Work Orders APIs all return 200.
/auth/me returns user info with email and permissions.
